NO-GO (operator decision 2026-09-10). Per-packet cost is ~a wash: no HMAC helper in tc-bpf means hand-rolling SipHash-2-4, whose cost is roughly the LRU_HASH lookup it would replace. The original benefit (eliminate the larger conntrack map + its eviction/flush-attack surface) DIED when the 2026-09-07 aie31.21 Option-A decision kept the map for affinity -- the MAC no longer removes the map, only makes the return leg stateless for auth. And it is redundant over beep's WireGuard cross-node underlay (return path already cryptographically authenticated); the bead required justifying against the weakest underlay, which is exactly where it adds least. DONE-WHEN satisfied: written no-go with underlay reasoning recorded.
